BOOK2_LESSON_SIX_PART_ONE.title: Grammar 1–6 · Let’s Go to KTV to Sing!

text.traditional: 下星期六是可欣的生日，我們要怎麼慶祝呢？
text.simplified: 下星期六是可欣的生日，我们要怎么庆祝呢？
text.pinyin: Xià xīngqíliù shì Kěxīn de shēngrì, wǒmen yào zěnme qìngzhù ne?
text.english: Next week is Kexin's birthday. How are we going to celebrate it?

text.traditional: 她愛唱歌，去KTV幫她過生日，好不好？
text.simplified: 她爱唱歌，去KTV帮她过生日，好不好？
text.pinyin: Tā ài chànggē, qù KTV bāng tā guò shēngrì, hǎo bù hǎo?
text.english: She loves singing. Let's go to a KTV bar and celebrate her birthday there, OK?

text.traditional: 太好了！我很想看看台灣的KTV，聽說跟日本的有點兒不同。
text.simplified: 太好了！我很想看看台湾的KTV，听说跟日本的有点儿不同。
text.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Wǒ hěn xiǎng kànkan Táiwān de KTV, tīngshuō gēn Rìběn de yǒudiǎnr bùtóng.
text.english: Great! I want to see the KTV in Taiwan. I heard it's a little bit different than in Japan.

text.traditional: 我覺得都差不多，可是很多台灣的KTV可以吃到飽。
text.simplified: 我觉得都差不多，可是很多台湾的KTV可以吃到饱。
text.pinyin: Wǒ juéde dōu chàbùduō, kěshì hěn duō Táiwān de KTV kěyǐ chīdàobǎo.
text.english: I think there's no big difference. But in many Taiwanese KTV bars, you can eat as much as you want.

text.traditional: 真的嗎？我沒聽過日本有吃到飽的KTV，不過，我去KTV的目的不是吃東西，是唱歌。
text.simplified: 真的吗？我没听过日本有吃到饱的KTV，不过，我去KTV的目的不是吃东西，是唱歌。
text.pinyin: Zhēnde ma? Wǒ méi tīng guò Rìběn yǒu chīdàobǎo de KTV, búguò, wǒ qù KTV de mùdì búshì chī dōngxi, shì chànggē.
text.english: Really? I haven't heard about any all-you-can-eat KTV bar in Japan. But the purpose I go to the KTV is to sing, not to eat.

text.traditional: 我聽說，日本人跟朋友去KTV的時候，每個人一次只能點一首歌，點好了就換下一個人，是真的嗎？
text.simplified: 我听说，日本人跟朋友去KTV的时候，每个人一次只能点一首歌，点好了就换下一个人，是真的吗？
text.pinyin: Wǒ tīngshuō, Rìběnrén gēn péngyǒu qù KTV de shíhòu, měi gè rén yí cì zhǐ néng diǎn yì shǒu gē, diǎn hǎo le jiù huàn xià yígerén, shì zhēnde ma?
text.english: I heard that when the Japanese go to KTV bars with friends, one person can order only one song each time. After ordering the song, it is another one's turn. Is that right?

text.traditional: 沒錯，跟台灣不一樣嗎？
text.simplified: 没错，跟台湾不一样吗？
text.pinyin: Méicuò, gēn Táiwān bù yíyàng ma?
text.english: That's right! Is it different from Taiwan?

text.traditional: 我們喜歡大家合唱，這樣比較熱鬧，唱錯了也沒關係。
text.simplified: 我们喜欢大家合唱，这样比较热闹，唱错了也没关系。
text.pinyin: Wǒmen xǐhuān dàjiā héchàng, zhèyàng bǐjiào rènao, chàng cuò le yě méiguānxi.
text.english: We like singing altogether. It's more lively that way and it doesn't matter if you sing it wrong.

text.traditional: 有一次我們在KTV唱歌，隔壁的人唱得好開心，又唱又跳，感覺地板都動起來了。
text.simplified: 有一次我们在KTV唱歌，隔壁的人唱得好开心，又唱又跳，感觉地板都动起来了。
text.pinyin: Yǒu yí cì wǒmen zài KTV chànggē, gébì de rén chàng de hǎo kāixīn, yòu chàng yòu tiào, gǎnjué dìbǎn dōu dòng qǐlái le.
text.english: Once while we were singing in a KTV bar, the people next door were singing so happily. They were both singing and dancing. It felt like the floor was starting to move.

text.traditional: 聽美心說你很會唱歌，可以教我唱中文歌嗎？
text.simplified: 听美心说你很会唱歌，可以教我唱中文歌吗？
text.pinyin: Tīng Měixīn shuō nǐ hěn huì chànggē, kěyǐ jiāo wǒ chàng Zhōngwén gē ma?
text.english: I heard from Meixin that you sing very well. Can you teach me how to sing Chinese songs?

text.traditional: 沒問題，我先教你唱簡單的，你一定很快就學會了。
text.simplified: 没问题，我先教你唱简单的，你一定很快就学会了。
text.pinyin: Méi wèntí, wǒ xiān jiāo nǐ chàng jiǎndān de, nǐ yídìng hěn kuài jiù xuéhuì le.
text.english: No problem. I'll teach you to sing the simple ones first. You'll learn it very fast for sure.

text.traditional: 台灣的KTV也有很多日文歌曲，你可以選幾首拿手的，在可欣生日那天，唱給大家聽。
text.simplified: 台湾的KTV也有很多日文歌曲，你可以选几首拿手的，在可欣生日那天，唱给大家听。
text.pinyin: Táiwān de KTV yě yǒu hěn duō Rìwén gēqǔ, nǐ kěyǐ xuǎn jǐ shǒu náshǒu de, zài Kěxīn shēngrì nà tiān, chàng gěi dàjiā tīng.
text.english: Taiwanese KTV bars have many Japanese songs, too. You can choose a few songs that you mastered and sing them for everyone on Kexin's birthday.

text.traditional: 可是我很容易緊張，要是唱不好怎麼辦？
text.simplified: 可是我很容易紧张，要是唱不好怎么办？
text.pinyin: Kěshì wǒ hěn róngyì jǐnzhāng, yàoshì chàng bùhǎo zěnmebàn?
text.english: But I get nervous very easily. What shall I do if I don't sing well?

text.traditional: 沒關係。我每次去KTV，總是把自己當歌星，想像那是我的演唱會，想唱什麼就唱什麼，自己開心最重要。
text.simplified: 没关系。我每次去KTV，总是把自己当歌星，想像那是我的演唱会，想唱什么就唱什么，自己开心最重要。
text.pinyin: Méiguānxi. Wǒ měi cì qù KTV, zǒngshì bǎ zìjǐ dāng gēxīng, xiǎngxiàng nà shì wǒ de yǎnchànghuì, xiǎng chàng shénme jiù chàng shénme, zìjǐ kāixīn zuì zhòngyào.
text.english: It doesn't matter. Every time I go to a KTV bar, I always act like a singer and imagine that was my concert. I sing what I want to sing. My own happiness is the most important.

text.traditional: 我看過一個日本的電視節目，在KTV唱歌的時候，用機器給唱歌的人打分數，這樣就可以知道自己唱得怎麼樣。
text.simplified: 我看过一个日本的电视节目，在KTV唱歌的时候，用机器给唱歌的人打分数，这样就可以知道自己唱得怎么样。
text.pinyin: Wǒ kàn guò yíge Rìběn de diànshì jiémù, zài KTV chànggē de shíhòu, yòng jīqì gěi chànggē de rén dǎfēnshù, zhèyàng jiù kěyǐ zhīdào zìjǐ chàng de zěnmeyàng.
text.english: I've seen a Japanese TV show. While people were singing in a KTV bar, they used a machine to score the singing. In that way they could find out how well they sang.

text.traditional: 聽起來好像是考試，好可怕！
text.simplified: 听起来好像是考试，好可怕！
text.pinyin: Tīngqǐlái hǎoxiàng shì kǎoshì, hǎo kěpà!
text.english: It sounds like an exam. So scary!

text.traditional: 那種機器常常弄錯，有時候我覺得唱得不差，可是分數很低。
text.simplified: 那种机器常常弄错，有时候我觉得唱得不差，可是分数很低。
text.pinyin: Nà zhǒng jīqì chángcháng nòngcuò, yǒushíhòu wǒ juéde chàng de bú chà, kěshì fēnshù hěn dī.
text.english: That kind of machine often goes wrong. Sometimes I think my singing is not bad, but the score is very low.

text.traditional: 哈哈哈！
text.simplified: 哈哈哈！
text.pinyin: Hāhāhā!
text.english: Hahaha! (laughing)

text.traditional: 我們去KTV那天，我教你一些唱歌的方法吧！
text.simplified: 我们去KTV那天，我教你一些唱歌的方法吧！
text.pinyin: Wǒmen qù KTV nà tiān, wǒ jiāo nǐ yìxiē chànggē de fāngfǎ ba!
text.english: Let me teach you some singing methods on the day we go to a KTV bar.

text.traditional: （興奮地說）太棒了！我一定會好好練習的，這樣就不怕機器給我打分數了。
text.simplified: （兴奋地说）太棒了！我一定会好好练习的，这样就不怕机器给我打分数了。
text.pinyin: (Xīngfèn de shuō) Tài bàng le! Wǒ yídìng huì hǎohǎo liànxí de, zhèyàng jiù bú pà jīqì gěi wǒ dǎfēnshù le.
text.english: (says excitedly) Awesome! I will definitely practice well, so I am not afraid of the machine giving me a score.

text.traditional: 對了，我們要買什麼禮物送給可欣呢？
text.simplified: 对了，我们要买什么礼物送给可欣呢？
text.pinyin: Duìle, wǒmen yào mǎi shénme lǐwù sòng gěi Kěxīn ne?
text.english: By the way, what gifts are we going to give Kexin?

text.traditional: （大家想一想）
text.simplified: （大家想一想）
text.pinyin: (Dàjiā xiǎng yì xiǎng)
text.english: (Everyone was thinking...)

text.traditional: 我想到了！可欣很喜歡香水，我們送她一瓶香水吧。
text.simplified: 我想到了！可欣很喜欢香水，我们送她一瓶香水吧。
text.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng dào le! Kěxīn hěn xǐhuān xiāngshuǐ, wǒmen sòng tā yì píng xiāngshuǐ ba.
text.english: I have an idea! Kexin likes perfume. Let's give her a bottle of perfume.

text.traditional: 我還要送她巧克力跟一大束紅玫瑰，九十九朵喔！
text.simplified: 我还要送她巧克力跟一大束红玫瑰，九十九朵喔！
text.pinyin: Wǒ háiyào sòng tā qiǎokèlì gēn yí dà shù hóng méigui, jiǔshíjiǔ duǒ o!
text.english: I also want to send her chocolate and a big bunch of red roses, with ninety-nine flowers!

text.traditional: 別忘了買蛋糕跟幾罐啤酒喔！
text.simplified: 别忘了买蛋糕跟几罐啤酒喔！
text.pinyin: Bié wàngle mǎi dàngāo gēn jǐ guàn píjiǔ o!
text.english: Don't forget to buy a cake and a few cans of beer!

text.traditional: 那麼等可欣下課以後，我就告訴她這個好消息。
text.simplified: 那么等可欣下课以后，我就告诉她这个好消息。
text.pinyin: Nàme děng Kěxīn xiàkè yǐhòu, wǒ jiù gàosu tā zhège hǎo xiāoxí.
text.english: Well, when Kexin finishes her classes, I'll tell her this piece of good news.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Let’s Go to KTV to Sing!
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that something is finished and ready, or done well or badly.
grammarPages.explanation: 「好」is placed after the verb and acts as a verb complement. When used together with a verb, 「好」serves as a verb complement denoting the action is finished with an ideal result.

text.traditional: 媽媽把明天要去野餐的東西都準備好了。
text.simplified: 妈妈把明天要去野餐的东西都准备好了。
text.pinyin: Māma bǎ míngtiān yào qù yěcān de dōngxi dōu zhǔnbèi hǎo le.
text.english: Mom has got everything for tomorrow's picnic ready.

text.traditional: 你還沒把功課寫好，不能出去踢足球。
text.simplified: 你还没把功课写好，不能出去踢足球。
text.pinyin: Nǐ háiméi bǎ gōngkè xiě hǎo, bùnéng chūqù tī zúqiú.
text.english: You haven't finished your homework yet; you can't go out to play soccer.

text.traditional: 學新的語言，要是你不常練習，當然學不好。
text.simplified: 学新的语言，要是你不常练习，当然学不好。
text.pinyin: Xué xīn de yǔyán, yàoshì nǐ bù cháng liànxí, dāngrán xué bù hǎo.
text.english: If you don't practice often, of course you won't learn a new language well.

text.traditional: 這份工作不簡單，你覺得他做得好做不好？
text.simplified: 这份工作不简单，你觉得他做得好做不好？
text.pinyin: Zhè fèn gōngzuò bù jiǎndān, nǐ juéde tā zuò de hǎo zuò bù hǎo?
text.english: This job is not easy. Do you think he can do it well or not?

grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: 「好」is placed after the verb and acts as a verb complement. When used together with a verb, 「好」serves as a verb complement denoting the action is finished with an ideal result.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Let’s Go to KTV to Sing!
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that someone did something wrong, or did not do it wrong.
grammarPages.explanation: 「錯」is placed after the verb, serving as the verb complement. V錯 indicates that the subject did something wrong. The result of the action is a mistake.

subsections.title: V錯了: did something wrong
subsections.explanation: 「錯」放在動詞後面，表示動作的結果是錯的；後面可以接受詞。

subsections.title: 沒V錯: did not do something wrong
subsections.explanation: 「沒」放在動詞前面，表示沒有做錯；不要再用「了」。

text.traditional: 他是黃先生不是王先生，你聽錯了。
text.simplified: 他是黄先生不是王先生，你听错了。
text.pinyin: Tā shì Huáng xiānshēng búshì Wáng xiānshēng, nǐ tīng cuò le.
text.english: He is Mr. Huang, not Mr. Wang; you heard wrong.

text.traditional: 今天早上我坐錯了車，所以上班遲到了。
text.simplified: 今天早上我坐错了车，所以上班迟到了。
text.pinyin: Jīntiān zǎoshàng wǒ zuò cuò le chē, suǒyǐ shàngbān chídào le.
text.english: This morning I took the wrong bus, so I was late for work.

text.traditional: A：我們要去看的演唱會是下個星期六不是這個星期六。B：真的嗎？我記錯了時間嗎？
text.simplified: A：我们要去看的演唱会是下个星期六不是这个星期六。B：真的吗？我记错了时间吗？
text.pinyin: A: Wǒmen yào qù kàn de yǎnchànghuì shì xià ge xīngqíliù búshì zhège xīngqíliù. B: Zhēnde ma? Wǒ jì cuò le shíjiān ma?
text.english: A: The concert we're going to is next Saturday, not this Saturday. B: Really? Did I remember the time wrong?

text.traditional: 孩子沒做錯事，你為什麼要打他？
text.simplified: 孩子没做错事，你为什么要打他？
text.pinyin: Háizi méi zuò cuò shì, nǐ wèishénme yào dǎ tā?
text.english: The child didn't do anything wrong; why do you want to hit him?

text.traditional: A：你吃了什麼？為什麼肚子疼呢？B：醫生說我沒吃錯東西，可能是飲料不新鮮。
text.simplified: A：你吃了什么？为什么肚子疼呢？B：医生说我没吃错东西，可能是饮料不新鲜。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ chī le shénme? Wèishénme dùzi téng ne? B: Yīshēng shuō wǒ méi chī cuò dōngxi, kěnéng shì yǐnliào bù xīnxiān.
text.english: A: What did you eat? Why does your stomach hurt? B: The doctor said I didn't eat the wrong thing; maybe the drink wasn't fresh.

text.traditional: A：你沒聽錯，李小姐真的明天要結婚了。B：可是她說她沒有男朋友啊！
text.simplified: A：你没听错，李小姐真的明天要结婚了。B：可是她说她没有男朋友啊！
text.pinyin: A: Nǐ méi tīng cuò, Lǐ xiǎojiě zhēnde míngtiān yào jiéhūn le. B: Kěshì tā shuō tā méi yǒu nánpéngyǒu a!
text.english: A: You didn't hear wrong; Miss Li really is getting married tomorrow. B: But she said she doesn't have a boyfriend!

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Let’s Go to KTV to Sing!
grammarPages.titleEnglish: V會: learning and teaching to mastery
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that someone learned or taught a skill successfully.
grammarPages.explanation: When used together with a verb, 「會」serves as a resultative complement. The verbs used in this pattern include 「學（learn）」 and 「教（teach）」, which indicate someone acquires certain techniques through learning or teaching.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + (沒 / V得 / V不) + 會 (+ Object)

text.traditional: 我學游泳，學了一個月就學會了。
text.simplified: 我学游泳，学了一个月就学会了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ xué yóuyǒng, xué le yíge yuè jiù xuéhuì le.
text.english: I was learning to swim, and within a month I had learned how.

text.traditional: 那個外國人還沒學會用筷子吃飯。
text.simplified: 那个外国人还没学会用筷子吃饭。
text.pinyin: Nàge wàiguórén háiméi xuéhuì yòng kuàizi chīfàn.
text.english: That foreigner still hasn't learned to eat with chopsticks.

text.traditional: 這首中文歌很容易，誰都學得會。
text.simplified: 这首中文歌很容易，谁都学得会。
text.pinyin: Zhè shǒu Zhōngwén gē hěn róngyì, shéi dōu xué de huì.
text.english: This Chinese song is very easy; anyone can learn it.

text.traditional: 那個孩子那麼小，爸爸教得會教不會他怎麼騎腳踏車？
text.simplified: 那个孩子那么小，爸爸教得会教不会他怎么骑脚踏车？
text.pinyin: Nàge háizi nàme xiǎo, bàba jiāo de huì jiāo bú huì tā zěnme qí jiǎotàchē?
text.english: That child is so small; can his father teach him how to ride a bike or not?

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: When used together with a verb, 「會」serves as a resultative complement. The verbs used in this pattern include 「學（learn）」 and 「教（teach）」, which indicate someone acquires certain techniques through learning or teaching.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: When used together with a verb, 「會」serves as a resultative complement. The verbs used in this pattern include 「學（learn）」 and 「教（teach）」, which indicate someone acquires certain techniques through learning or teaching.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Let’s Go to KTV to Sing!
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that any person, thing, place, or way will do.
grammarPages.explanation: The two question words, which show a tone of randomness, represent the same thing and indicate there is no special requirement or limitation as long as the requirement going before 「就」 is fulfilled. If the question word is 「誰（who）」, the second 「誰」 can be placed before 「就」, e.g., 「這個巧克力，誰想吃誰就吃。」 The question words include: 誰（who）, 什麼時候（when）, 哪裡／哪兒（where）, 什麼（what）, 幾＋M（＋N）（how many）, 哪＋M（＋N）（which）, 怎麼（how）, etc.

text.traditional: 他很有錢，想買什麼就買什麼。
text.simplified: 他很有钱，想买什么就买什么。
text.pinyin: Tā hěn yǒu qián, xiǎng mǎi shénme jiù mǎi shénme.
text.english: He is rich; he buys whatever he wants to buy.

text.traditional: 媽媽今天做了很多包子，你想吃幾個就吃幾個。
text.simplified: 妈妈今天做了很多包子，你想吃几个就吃几个。
text.pinyin: Māma jīntiān zuò le hěn duō bāozi, nǐ xiǎng chī jǐ ge jiù chī jǐ ge.
text.english: Mom made a lot of steamed buns today; you can eat as many as you want.

text.traditional: A：新年快到了，你想去哪裡跨年？B：哪裡熱鬧就去哪裡。
text.simplified: A：新年快到了，你想去哪里跨年？B：哪里热闹就去哪里。
text.pinyin: A: Xīnnián kuài dào le, nǐ xiǎng qù nǎlǐ kuànián? B: Nǎlǐ rènao jiù qù nǎlǐ.
text.english: A: New Year is almost here; where do you want to go to celebrate? B: I'll go wherever it's lively.

text.traditional: A：我們要怎麼去合歡山？B：怎麼去比較方便就怎麼去。
text.simplified: A：我们要怎么去合欢山？B：怎么去比较方便就怎么去。
text.pinyin: A: Wǒmen yào zěnme qù Héhuān Shān? B: Zěnme qù bǐjiào fāngbiàn jiù zěnme qù.
text.english: A: How should we get to Hehuan Mountain? B: We'll go whichever way is more convenient.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The two question words, which show a tone of randomness, represent the same thing and indicate there is no special requirement or limitation as long as the requirement going before 「就」 is fulfilled. If the question word is 「誰（who）」, the second 「誰」 can be placed before 「就」, e.g., 「這個巧克力，誰想吃誰就吃。」 The question words include: 誰（who）, 什麼時候（when）, 哪裡／哪兒（where）, 什麼（what）, 幾＋M（＋N）（how many）, 哪＋M（＋N）（which）, 怎麼（how）, etc.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Let’s Go to KTV to Sing!
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Assure someone that something will very likely happen.
grammarPages.explanation: This pattern indicates the speaker believes the situation after 「會」 is quite likely to happen. 「的」 in this pattern is added to show affirmation with a more softened tone.

text.traditional: 李小姐的成績很好，畢業後一定會找到好工作的。
text.simplified: 李小姐的成绩很好，毕业后一定会找到好工作的。
text.pinyin: Lǐ xiǎojiě de chéngjī hěn hǎo, bìyè hòu yídìng huì zhǎodào hǎo gōngzuò de.
text.english: Miss Li's grades are very good; she will definitely find a good job after graduation.

text.traditional: 醫生說，多休息、多喝水，我的感冒很快就會好的。
text.simplified: 医生说，多休息、多喝水，我的感冒很快就会好的。
text.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō, duō xiūxí, duō hē shuǐ, wǒ de gǎnmào hěn kuài jiù huì hǎo de.
text.english: The doctor said that with more rest and more water, my cold will get better very soon.

text.traditional: A：我很想去法國留學，可是怕父母不同意。B：只要好好地跟他們說，他們不會不同意的。
text.simplified: A：我很想去法国留学，可是怕父母不同意。B：只要好好地跟他们说，他们不会不同意的。
text.pinyin: A: Wǒ hěn xiǎng qù Fǎguó liúxué, kěshì pà fùmǔ bù tóngyì. B: Zhǐyào hǎohǎo de gēn tāmen shuō, tāmen bú huì bù tóngyì de.
text.english: A: I really want to study abroad in France, but I'm afraid my parents won't agree. B: As long as you talk to them nicely, they won't disagree.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This pattern indicates the speaker believes the situation after 「會」 is quite likely to happen. 「的」 in this pattern is added to show affirmation with a more softened tone.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This pattern indicates the speaker believes the situation after 「會」 is quite likely to happen. 「的」 in this pattern is added to show affirmation with a more softened tone.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Let’s Go to KTV to Sing!
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say what someone does once something else happens, or that they didn't wait for it.
grammarPages.explanation: This pattern indicates when something happens, someone will perform an action. Negation words 「不」 and 「沒」 should be placed before 「等」.
grammarPages.pattern: 等 + Situation, + Subject + 就 + Result

text.traditional: 有很多人沒等舞會結束，就先走了。
text.simplified: 有很多人没等舞会结束，就先走了。
text.pinyin: Yǒu hěn duō rén méi děng wǔhuì jiéshù, jiù xiān zǒu le.
text.english: Many people did not wait for the dance to end and left early.

text.traditional: 等這個學期結束，我就不要住在宿舍了。
text.simplified: 等这个学期结束，我就不要住在宿舍了。
text.pinyin: Děng zhège xuéqí jiéshù, wǒ jiù búyào zhù zài sùshè le.
text.english: Once this semester ends, I don't want to live in the dormitory anymore.

text.traditional: 等夏天來了，我們就可以去海邊曬太陽、游泳了。
text.simplified: 等夏天来了，我们就可以去海边晒太阳、游泳了。
text.pinyin: Děng xiàtiān lái le, wǒmen jiù kěyǐ qù hǎibiān shài tàiyáng, yóuyǒng le.
text.english: When summer comes, we can go to the beach to sunbathe and swim.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This pattern indicates when something happens, someone will perform an action. Negation words 「不」 and 「沒」 should be placed before 「等」.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This pattern indicates when something happens, someone will perform an action. Negation words 「不」 and 「沒」 should be placed before 「等」.

text.traditional: 在台灣，KTV是一個吃喝玩樂的好地方。很多人會到KTV過生日、辦活動；不少學生一考完試就去KTV唱歌、吃東西，讓自己輕鬆一下。有人家裡有卡拉OK的機器，不但想唱的時候隨時都能唱，也可以請朋友、鄰居一起來唱。
text.simplified: 在台湾，KTV是一个吃喝玩乐的好地方。很多人会到KTV过生日、办活动；不少学生一考完试就去KTV唱歌、吃东西，让自己轻松一下。有人家里有卡拉OK的机器，不但想唱的时候随时都能唱，也可以请朋友、邻居一起来唱。
text.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, KTV shì yíge chīhēwánlè de hǎo dìfāng. Hěn duō rén huì dào KTV guò shēngrì, bàn huódòng; bùshǎo xuéshēng yì kǎo wán shì jiù qù KTV chànggē, chī dōngxi, ràng zìjǐ qīngsōng yíxià. Yǒu rén jiā lǐ yǒu kǎlā OK de jīqì, búdàn xiǎng chàng de shíhòu suíshí dōu néng chàng, yě kěyǐ qǐng péngyǒu, línjū yìqǐ lái chàng.
text.english: In Taiwan, KTV is a good place to eat, drink, and have fun. Many people will go to KTV bars to sing when they celebrate birthdays or organize activities. Many students go to KTV bars to sing, eat, and relax themselves right after exams. Some people also have karaoke sets at home. They can not only sing whenever they want but also invite their friends and neighbors to sing together.

text.traditional: 台灣的KTV是二十四小時的，你想什麼時候去唱歌都可以。不同的時間，價錢也不同，早上六點到中午十二點前最便宜，一個人才兩百多塊錢。週末、假日比平日貴得多，還常常客滿，所以很多大學生利用沒課時去KTV，不但省錢，也不需要排隊。
text.simplified: 台湾的KTV是二十四小时的，你想什么时候去唱歌都可以。不同的时间，价钱也不同，早上六点到中午十二点前最便宜，一个人才两百多块钱。周末、假日比平日贵得多，还常常客满，所以很多大学生利用没课时去KTV，不但省钱，也不需要排队。
text.pinyin: Táiwān de KTV shì èrshísì xiǎoshí de, nǐ xiǎng shénme shíhòu qù chànggē dōu kěyǐ. Bùtóng de shíjiān, jiàqián yě bùtóng, zǎoshàng liù diǎn dào zhōngwǔ shí'èr diǎn qián zuì piányí, yíge rén cái liǎngbǎi duō kuài qián. Zhōumò, jiàrì bǐ píngrì guì de duō, hái chángcháng kèmǎn, suǒyǐ hěn duō dàxuéshēng lìyòng méi kè shí qù KTV, búdàn shěngqián, yě bù xūyào páiduì.
text.english: The KTV bars in Taiwan are open 24 hours a day. You can go there and sing whenever you want. The price is different for different times. From 6 am to 12:00 noon is the cheapest, only a bit over $200 for a person. Though weekends and holidays are much more expensive than weekdays, the bars are often full. Therefore, many university students use the time when they have no classes to go to KTV bars. Not only can they save money, but they also don't need to line up.

text.traditional: 台灣的KTV還有一個特色，就是有各式各樣的食物和飲料。只要你多付一點兒錢，就可以吃到飽，不必擔心唱著唱著就餓了。有的KTV還有好玩的樂器，讓客人唱得更開心。其實，也有人生氣或是傷心的時候，會自己一個人去KTV，一邊唱、一邊哭，等唱完以後，心情就好多了。
text.simplified: 台湾的KTV还有一个特色，就是有各式各样的食物和饮料。只要你多付一点儿钱，就可以吃到饱，不必担心唱着唱着就饿了。有的KTV还有好玩的乐器，让客人唱得更开心。其实，也有人生气或是伤心的时候，会自己一个人去KTV，一边唱、一边哭，等唱完以后，心情就好多了。
text.pinyin: Táiwān de KTV háiyǒu yíge tèsè, jiùshì yǒu gèshìgèyàng de shíwù hé yǐnliào. Zhǐyào nǐ duō fù yìdiǎnr qián, jiù kěyǐ chīdàobǎo, búbì dānxīn chàng zhe chàng zhe jiù è le. Yǒude KTV háiyǒu hǎowán de yuèqì, ràng kèrén chàng de gèng kāixīn. Qíshí, yě yǒu rén shēngqì huòshì shāngxīn de shíhòu, huì zìjǐ yígerén qù KTV, yìbiān chàng, yìbiān kū, děng chàng wán yǐhòu, xīnqíng jiù hǎo duō le.
text.english: Taiwanese KTV bars have another special feature—that is, a wide range of food and beverages. As long as you pay a little more, you can eat as much as you want. You do not have to worry that you'll get hungry while singing. Some KTV bars also have funny musical instruments, so that the guests can enjoy their singing more. Actually, there are also some people who go alone to a KTV bar when they are angry or sad. They cry while singing. When they finish singing, their moods become much better.

text.traditional: 要是你想慶祝生日，去KTV跟大家合唱，一定會很開心的；如果心情不好，去KTV自己一個人唱歌，也能把不愉快的事情忘了，所以去KTV真是一個不錯的選擇。
text.simplified: 要是你想庆祝生日，去KTV跟大家合唱，一定会很开心的；如果心情不好，去KTV自己一个人唱歌，也能把不愉快的事情忘了，所以去KTV真是一个不错的选择。
text.pinyin: Yàoshì nǐ xiǎng qìngzhù shēngrì, qù KTV gēn dàjiā héchàng, yídìng huì hěn kāixīn de; rúguǒ xīnqíng bùhǎo, qù KTV zìjǐ yígerén chànggē, yě néng bǎ bù yúkuài de shìqíng wàngle, suǒyǐ qù KTV zhēnshì yíge búcuò de xuǎnzé.
text.english: If you want to celebrate your birthday, go to KTV bars to sing with people, you must be very happy; if you are in a bad mood, go to KTV bars to sing on your own, you can also forget the unpleasant things. So going to KTV bars is really a good choice.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Let’s Go to KTV to Sing!
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Stress that a number is smaller than expected.
grammarPages.explanation: This pattern indicates the number is fewer than the speaker's expectation, different from the usage of 「才」 in Lesson Two. Both 「才」 and 「只」 imply a small number. However, 「才」 emphasizes the small number is the speaker's subjective opinion. Also, 「才」 can be followed directly with number words; 「只」 is placed before the verb and cannot be followed with number words, e.g., 「＊這件衣服只一百塊錢。」

text.traditional: 今天咖啡館裡才三個人，客人真少。
text.simplified: 今天咖啡馆里才三个人，客人真少。
text.pinyin: Jīntiān kāfēiguǎn lǐ cái sān ge rén, kèrén zhēn shǎo.
text.english: There are only three people in the café today; there are really few customers.

text.traditional: 我今天中午才吃了一個麵包，現在好餓。
text.simplified: 我今天中午才吃了一个面包，现在好饿。
text.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān zhōngwǔ cái chī le yíge miànbāo, xiànzài hǎo è.
text.english: I only ate one piece of bread at noon today; I'm so hungry now.

text.traditional: A：那個孩子籃球打得很好，他學了很久吧？B：老師說他很聰明，才教了半個月就教會（他）了。
text.simplified: A：那个孩子篮球打得很好，他学了很久吧？B：老师说他很聪明，才教了半个月就教会（他）了。
text.pinyin: A: Nàge háizi lánqiú dǎ de hěn hǎo, tā xué le hěn jiǔ ba? B: Lǎoshī shuō tā hěn cōngmíng, cái jiāo le bàn ge yuè jiù jiāo huì (tā) le.
text.english: A: That child plays basketball very well. He must have been learning for a long time, right? B: The teacher said he is very smart; after only half a month of teaching, he had already learned it.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This pattern indicates the number is fewer than the speaker's expectation, different from the usage of 「才」 in Lesson Two. Both 「才」 and 「只」 imply a small number. However, 「才」 emphasizes the small number is the speaker's subjective opinion. Also, 「才」 can be followed directly with number words; 「只」 is placed before the verb and cannot be followed with number words, e.g., 「＊這件衣服只一百塊錢。」

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Let’s Go to KTV to Sing!
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that something makes someone feel a certain way.
grammarPages.explanation: In the pattern 「A 讓 B + Vs」, A is the cause that makes B have certain feelings.

text.traditional: 朋友送了我一個生日蛋糕，讓我很開心。
text.simplified: 朋友送了我一个生日蛋糕，让我很开心。
text.pinyin: Péngyǒu sòng le wǒ yíge shēngrì dàngāo, ràng wǒ hěn kāixīn.
text.english: A friend gave me a birthday cake, which made me very happy.

text.traditional: 爸爸開了八個小時的車，讓他累得不得了。
text.simplified: 爸爸开了八个小时的车，让他累得不得了。
text.pinyin: Bàba kāi le bā ge xiǎoshí de chē, ràng tā lèi de bùdéliǎo.
text.english: Dad drove for eight hours, which made him incredibly tired.

text.traditional: 昨天吃了不乾淨的東西，讓我的肚子不太舒服。
text.simplified: 昨天吃了不干净的东西，让我的肚子不太舒服。
text.pinyin: Zuótiān chī le bù gānjìng de dōngxi, ràng wǒ de dùzi bú tài shūfu.
text.english: Yesterday I ate something unclean, which made my stomach feel a bit uncomfortable.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: In the pattern 「A 讓 B + Vs」, A is the cause that makes B have certain feelings.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: In the pattern 「A 讓 B + Vs」, A is the cause that makes B have certain feelings.
